versos.texto_bv: Assim diz o SENHOR dos Exércitos: “Rebuscarão totalmente o remanescente de Israel, como numa vinha; volte a passar a mão, como o vindimador sobre os ramos.”
versos.traducao_literal: Assim disse SENHOR Exércitos: rebuscar rebuscarão como-a-vinha resto-de Israel; volta tua-mão como-vindimador sobre cestos.
objecoes: Objeção MATERIAL (revisão ER-0022): texto_bv traz 'sobre os ramos', mas o termo hebraico סַלְסִלּוֹת (lemma 5552) designa cestos, exatamente como a própria traducao_literal ('sobre cestos') e o controle KJV ('into the baskets') registram; a imagem de colher uvas 'sobre os ramos' diverge da de recolhê-las 'nos cestos'. — evidência: traducao_literal: '...como-vindimador sobre cestos'; controles.kjv: 'as a grapegatherer into the baskets'; termos_originais: סַלְסִלּוֹת lemma 5552.

kjv.texto: Thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall throughly glean the remnant of Israel as a vine: turn back thine hand as a grapegatherer into the baskets.

vizinhos.8: Be thou instructed, O Jerusalem, lest my soul depart from thee; lest I make thee desolate, a land not inhabited.
vizinhos.10: To whom shall I speak, and give warning, that they may hear? behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they cannot hearken: behold, the word of the Lord is unto them a reproach; they have no delight in it.

web.texto: Thus says Yahweh of Armies, “They shall thoroughly glean the remnant of Israel like a vine. Turn again your hand as a grape gatherer into the baskets.”

vizinhos.8: Be instructed, Jerusalem, lest my soul be alienated from you; lest I make you a desolation, a land not inhabited.”
vizinhos.10: To whom shall I speak and testify, that they may hear? Behold, their ear is uncircumcised, and they can’t listen. Behold, Yahweh’s word has become a reproach to them. They have no delight in it.
